title: A Prospective Study of Misoprostol Administration in Asymptomatic Patients With Pregnancies of Unknown Location
brief_summary: A randomized prospective double blind study of misoprostol administration in asymptomatic patients with pregnancies of unknown location.
raw_criteria:
